constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (umbrella_id) REFERENCES umbrellas(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: chk_candidates_tms_ref_format
constraints.definition: CHECK (((tms_ref IS NULL) OR (tms_ref ~ '^CCR-[0-9]{5,}$'::text))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: contracts_bucket_labels_json_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((bucket_labels_json IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(bucket_labels_json) = 'object'::text) AND ((bucket_labels_json - ARRAY['day'::text, 'night'::text, 'sat'::text, 'sun'::text, 'bh'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (bucket_labels_json ? 'day'::text) AND (bucket_labels_json ? 'night'::text) AND (bucket_labels_json ? 'sat'::text) AND (bucket_labels_json ? 'sun'::text) AND (bucket_labels_json ? 'bh'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim((bucket_labels_json ->> 'day'::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim((bucket_labels_json ->> 'night'::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim((bucket_labels_json ->> 'sat'::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim((bucket_labels_json ->> 'sun'::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim((bucket_labels_json ->> 'bh'::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: contracts_client_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: contracts_mileage_nonneg_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((mileage_pay_rate IS NULL) OR (mileage_pay_rate >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((mileage_charge_rate IS NULL) OR (mileage_charge_rate >= (0)::numeric))))

constraints.name: contracts_no_ts_requires_hr_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((COALESCE(no_timesheet_required, false) = false) OR (COALESCE(autoprocess_hr, false) = true)))

constraints.name: contracts_route_one_source_chk
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((
CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(is_nhsp, false) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END +
CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(autoprocess_hr, false) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) <= 1))

constraints.name: contracts_ts_query_email_override_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT send_ts_queries_to_different_email) OR ((NULLIF(btrim(ts_queries_alt_email_address), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(ts_queries_alt_email_address)) <= 320))))

constraints.name: contracts_weekly_source_no_ts_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((weekly_timesheet_source IS NULL) OR (weekly_timesheet_source = 'HEALTHROSTER'::weekly_timesheet_source_enum) OR (COALESCE(no_timesheet_required, false) = false)))

constraints.name: weekly_source_cycles_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> 'FINALISED'::text) OR ((finalised_at_utc IS NOT NULL) AND (finalised_by_user_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (source_group_id, finalisation_week_ending, scope_client_id)

constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (client_id WITH =, daterange(valid_from, COALESCE(valid_to, 'infinity'::date), '[]'::text) WITH &&)

constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (source_group_id, client_id, valid_from, valid_to)

constraints.name: weekly_source_row_resolutions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((mapping_state = 'RESOLVED'::text) = ((candidate_id IS NOT NULL) AND (client_id IS NOT NULL) AND (contract_id IS NOT NULL) AND (work_event_id IS NOT NULL) AND (blocker_code IS NULL))))

constraints.name: weekly_source_row_resolutions_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((mapping_state = 'RESOLVED'::text) = ((work_event_match_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (work_event_match_fingerprint IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((start_at_local IS NULL) OR (end_at_local IS NULL) OR (end_at_local > start_at_local)))

constraints.name: weekly_source_upload_rows_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((break_minutes IS NULL) OR (start_at_local IS NULL) OR (end_at_local IS NULL) OR (break_minutes <= ((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (end_at_local - start_at_local)) / (60)::numeric))::integer)))

constraints.name: weekly_source_upload_rows_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((row_finalisation_state <> ALL (ARRAY['NOT_APPLICABLE'::text, 'SOURCE_WORKED'::text])) OR ((start_at_local IS NOT NULL) AND (end_at_local IS NOT NULL) AND (break_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (actual_net_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (actual_net_minutes > 0))))

constraints.name: weekly_source_upload_rows_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT (source_shift_charge_pence IS DISTINCT FROM (source_commission_pence + source_total_cost_pence))) OR (source_commission_pence IS NULL) OR (source_total_cost_pence IS NULL)))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> ALL (ARRAY['SEALED'::text, 'CURRENT'::text, 'SUPERSEDED'::text, 'CORRECTION_READY'::text])) OR (physical_row_count = (((((header_count + trailer_count) + continuation_count) + accepted_count) + blocking_economic_duplicate_count) + malformed_count))))
